ledger.summary: At dawn Ursula reveals herself unarmed, then re-arms. She stole her gilded armour, marked with Utterbol's token, from the Lord's nephew, half lover and half tyrant to her. She gives Ralph a short Turk bow. They ride through the pine wood seeking a stream that runs straight down from the high ground where the Sage lives (not from the Great Mountains); the stream Ralph followed turns north toward Utterbol. Men fear the wood, so thieves are few, but Utterbol riders may pursue. She swears by the beads to live as long as they can. She tells how Bull Nosy loved her, was gentle as a brother, foresaw his death, and was slain when the Lord of Utterbol came upon them in the Goldburg mountains: Bull refused to sell her and threatened the Lord, who had his swordsman cleave Bull's skull. She resisted the Lord's demands by threatening to kill him or herself, and came to Utterbol unharmed.
ledger.geography_notes: The stream Ralph followed would lead at last to Utterbol (it turns north). Another stream runs straight down from the high ground of the Sage's dwelling. The Lord's camp was under a big rock by the cliffs in the mountains of Goldburg.
